queries: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS byte_rate FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.average_rate;

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(r.byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate, AVG(r.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(r.byte_rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_byte_rate FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.byte_rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: NULL Bytes are ignored by SUM. A group whose byte rate is undefined because all Bytes are NULL or total Milliseconds is zero is excluded from the rate averages.
